text: Bringer of Conquest: The random allied Melee Creeps are deployed into Kanna's lane.

cases.name: rq_22_kanna_lane: both random lane creeps deploy into Kanna's lane; the opponent's keep their random lanes
rq_22_kanna_planned: a Kanna in the Fountain is not on the board when the creeps are assigned: deployed this phase, she redirects nothing (random lanes)
rq_22_kanna_private: a ready Kanna in the Fountain publishes no redirect; her planned lane stays private and changes no published creep lane
rq_22_kanna_private: with Kanna in a lane the creeps are published in her (public) lane at once; another hero's plan stays private and changes nothing
rq_22_kanna_not_ready: a Kanna in the Fountain who cannot deploy this round redirects nothing (random lanes)
rq_22_kanna_dead: a Kanna that dies in combat is in the Fountain at the next deployment: the creeps use their random lanes
only the random lane creeps follow her: a summoned Melee Creep stays in its lane
a Kanna silenced this round still redirects at the next deployment phase (a passive, RQ-31; silence also ends with the round)
